messages:
emma (partnerships): quick sync needed on marketplace onramp pricing mechanics — focusing on: SKU gating rules, a 'reservation slope' (gradual commit requirement), and an explicit renewal opt-in for private offers. want alignment with HW partners & SI timelines. @vikas-sales @sasha-legal :eyes:
omar (pricing): +1 to reservation slope. propose three bands: trial (0-90d, full credits), ramp (91-270d, partial credits), committed (>=365d, no credits). define prorate behavior when customers change bands mid-billing-cycle.
sasha-legal: legal note: no silent renewals. renewal opt-in must be explicit in contract UI and in the addendum. if partner wants co-terms, allow extra review time. i'll need partner MSA doc to advise on custom clauses.
vikas-sales: from GTM: need clear sales-facing SKUs (marketing name + internal SKU) and an SFDC impact calc template. recommend a 60d notice window for renewal decisions to avoid churn surprises. also want an "early adopter" marketing credit for a handful of pilot customers.
jenna-ops: ops/billing: we need a standard JSON schema for credit rules so billing can apply them deterministically. sample suggestion: 
```json
{
  "sku":"redwood.dedicated.gpu.p100x2",
  "bands":[
    {"id":"trial","days":90,"credit_pct":100},
    {"id":"ramp","days":180,"credit_pct":50},
    {"id":"committed","days":365,"credit_pct":0}
  ],
  "prorate_policy":"daily",
  "exclusions":["partner_credits"]
}
```
raj-eng: engineering can implement meter->band join and an idempotent discount executor. need fields: meter_id, sku, band_id, credit_pct, effective_ts, invoice_behavior (credit_on_invoice | post_bill_rebate). i'll create issue + PR template. also we should add unit tests for band transitions.
marta-marketing: launch & partner comms: need signed MSA and co-marketing approval before public announcement. recommend waiting until 1 pilot reserved deployment is live for case study asset. allow 2 weeks creative lead time.
emma (partnerships): proposed timeline: legal validation by Apr 4, pricing calc final by Apr 6, ops/eng artifacts by Apr 10, marketing creative ready Apr 20, pilot go-live Apr 27. are these doable?
sasha-legal: Apr 4 ok if partner accepts our standard addendum. if not, push to Apr 11.
jenna-ops: engineering work looks like 5 business days; add 3 days for billing QA -> Apr 13. ops prefers the later date to be safe.
omar (pricing): one important rule: discounts must be non-stackable unless explicitly allowed. ensure discount math is idempotent for mid-cycle band switches. i'll document formulas and edge cases by Apr 6.
vikas-sales: pilot ask: i'll surface 4 potential pilots tomorrow. one request: can we offer a one-time $10k marketing credit + co-branded webinar to first two closed pilots? marketing credit limited to N months and not combinable.
marta-marketing: co-branded webinar is feasible; need partner logo/approval workflow. i'll draft a promo checklist.
sasha-legal: marketing credit ok if we include cap & usage limits in the addendum and exclude stacking with other offers.
emma (partnerships): action owners:
- sasha-legal: confirm MSA vs addendum by EOD Mon (owner: sasha-legal)
- omar (pricing): finalize slope bands, proration rules, non-stackable exclusions by Apr 6
- raj-eng + jenna-ops: PR and billing schema + tests by Apr 10 (QA finish Apr 13)
- marta-marketing: co-marketing checklist + creative request list by Apr 14
- vikas-sales: pilot list + sales pitch kit by Apr 6
please reply with any blockers.
vikas-sales: noted. i'll send pilot roster and initial pitch slides tomorrow. one more commercial ask: can we include a SKU-level usage floor for dedicated capacity to protect HW partner economics? suggestion: min monthly consumption guaranteed or commit buy-down.
omar (pricing): usage floor is workable; will model impact on partner margin and customer elasticity. keep floors simple (e.g., 50 GPU-hours/month per SKU) and allow exceptions via partnership ops.
jenna-ops: for floors we'll need billing alarms and alerts for underutilization, plus a reconciliation flow. add to ops backlog.
raj-eng: added issue #4452 for credit executor & #4453 for floor-alarm integration.
marta-marketing: noted timing constraints for partner approvals; will not start creative work until legal confirms.
emma (partnerships): good conversation. i'll compile notes and update partnership tracker. closing thread; will follow up in next sync. :handshake:
